name: VRM_MEA_DOC_HEADERS
description: This object stores the header attributes of the multiple element arrangements.

columns.name: MEA_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: MEA_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: MEA_DATE
columns.description: Date on which MEA is created, derived from the earliest date of MEA lines and belongs to MEA transaction.

columns.name: MEA_HASH_CODE
columns.description: MEA processing unique identifier.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the MEA transaction.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a bill to customer party.

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name of a bill to customer.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a legal entity.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of a legal entity.

columns.name: MEA_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification code of a MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_CLASSIFICATION.

columns.name: MEA_RULE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the MEA identification rule.

columns.name: MEA_END_DATE
columns.description: The last transaction date of MEA line of a MEA.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE_STATUS
columns.description: Compliance status of a MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_COMPLIANCE_STATUS.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STATUS
columns.description: Adjustment status of MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_ADJ_STATUS.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_METHOD
columns.description: Carve out method that specifies a revenue complaince adjustment for a MEA. The valid values from VRM_MEA_CRAVEOUT_METHOD lookup are Relative and Residual.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date used for carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: TOTAL_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total fair market value amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: RECOGNIZED_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue amount which has already been recognized already.

columns.name: DEFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the revenue is being deferred. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: DEFERRED_REV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total deferred revenue amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: ELEMENT_COUNT
columns.description: Count of a unique item classification.

columns.name: TOTAL_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total line amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount that was billed for a MEA transaction.

columns.name: ARRANGEMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of a multiple element arrangements.

columns.name: AMOUNT_REQUIRING_ATTENTION
columns.description: Total amount requiring attention of MEA.

columns.name: LINES_REQUIRING_ATTENTION
columns.description: Number of MEA lines which require a revenue analyst or manager's attention.

columns.name: LINES_PENDING_PRICE_CALC_COUNT
columns.description: Number of MEA lines which is pending on VSOE price calculation.

columns.name: LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Count of all Multiple Element Arrangement lines.

columns.name: REFERENCE
columns.description: Reference used to identify a MEA.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
